g.text: BC-04 Sales Commitment — Tactical Domain Model (TARGET / V1)
+canCommit(request: PurchaseRequest, backing: BackingDecision, credit: CreditDecision): boolean
PR -> Commitment -> SO ownership transfer has no release/re-reserve gap.
RequestDraft prepares submission data; the factory creates the PurchaseRequest after orchestration.
BC-05 backing and BC-07 credit are stable decision references, not compositions.

ResolvedOfferSnapshot is the Published Language contract from BC-03 with canonical fields skuId, unitPrice, termsSnapshot, optional promotionId [0..1] and effectiveAt; BC-04 does not recompute pricing policy, and the contract is not a Published Integration Event or shared aggregate.
